remarks: In the heart of downtown New Canaan, this 6,000+ sq. ft. residence offers 5 bedrooms, 4 full baths, and 3 half baths, blending elegance and comfort.   The main level features a gourmet chef's kitchen with Wolf appliances, an expansive family room, and two dedicated offices. Soaring 9+ ft. ceilings enhance the light-filled interiors.Upstairs, the primary suite is a true retreat, boasting two-story windows, a spa-inspired bath, and a custom dressing room. Three additional bedrooms, two full baths, and a large second-floor laundry complete the level. The lower level is an entertainer's dream, with a home theater, wine cellar, and wet bar. Outside, expert landscaping, stone walkways, and a full outdoor kitchen set the stage for luxurious al fresco living. A private in-law/au pair suite above the garage offers a living room, bedroom, bath, and kitchenette-ideal for guests or extended family. This extraordinary home combines luxury and location-a must-see! Schedule your private tour today.
